g.text: RestNotes - domain classes and JDBC lease projection
Selected fields only; common UUID/timestamp/version bases are omitted.
Lines express UUID/FK relationships, NOT bidirectional JPA object collections.
NoteTagId(noteId,tagId). Composite FKs enforce same-team notebook/note/tag ownership.
Lease is a JDBC projection of note_locks, not a JPA entity; note_id is the table key.
NoteHistory's initial snapshot is a service invariant, not a minimum-row SQL constraint.
Comment REST and history/activity read/restore REST remain deferred.
